entries.name: Evolution
entries.content: When a pokémon 'Evolves', it gains a new body and new abilities, often becoming larger, stronger, and overall more powerful. Eevees are special among Pokemon, as they can evolve into one of eight different forms, each with different abilities, biology, and requirements. The eight evolutions available to an Eevee are: Vaporeon, Jolteon, Flareon, Espeon, Umbreon, Leafeon, Glaceon, Sylveon. These evolutions to Eevee altogether are known as "eeveelutions". An Eevee's name will change upon evolution, changing to whatever it evolves into.

entries.name: Evolution Stones (for Eevee only)
entries.content:
Evolution Stones{These stones contain an energy they radiate that causes certain species of pokémon to evolve upon contact. They are rare, so they aren't easy to come by, but some shops sell them for a high price. These stones are "consumed" upon use for evolution and disappear in a shine of light, leaving no trace of it behind,
“Water Stone”: "A semi-transparent, clear blue roughly-oblong polygonal stone with several air bubbles suspended inside it."
“Thunder Stone“: "A semi-transparent, oblong, polygonal clear green stone with a yellow zig-zag pattern at its center, reminiscent of a thunderbolt."
“Fire Stone“: "A semi-transparent, oblong, polygonal yellowish-orange stone with a fiery pattern at its heart, resembling a flame encased inside it."
“Sun Stone“: "A peculiar, orange-colored stone, shaped like the sun."
“Dusk Stone“: "A semi-transparent, oblong shaped, purplish-black stone with a dark center, possessing a mesmerizing darkness."
“Leaf Stone“: "A flat-faced green stone with an unmistakable dark-green leaf-imprint pattern."
“Ice Stone“: "A semi-transparent, roughly-oblong, clear light-blue stone with a hexagonal, six-pronged, three-forked snowflake pattern inside of it at its heart."},
System Note: [This list only includes evolution stones that can be used by Eevee to evolve, and is not the complete list of evolution stones.].

entries.name: Typings
entries.content:
All pokémon have specific types of elements that they're classified as. Eevee, which is a normal type, can only evolve into eight different pokémon types.
Some of these are natural concepts, like water, electric, fire, grass, and ice type.
Some of these are more fantastical, like psychic, dark, and fairy type.
This isn't the whole list of types, but there are only 8 evolutions of Eevee.

entries.name: The meaning of Eeveelution
entries.content: The term "eeveelution" is a combination of the words "Eevee" and "evolution". This word is assigned to the many evolutions of Eevee.
